German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

beraten +‎ -er

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /bəˈʁaːtɐ/
  • Audio (Austria):(file)
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

Berater m (strong, genitive Beraters, plural Berater, feminine Beraterin)

  1. agent noun of beraten: adviser / advisor, consultant

Declension

[edit]
Declension of Berater [masculine, strong]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun

dative einem dem Berater den Beratern
